spec.expr:
WITH (
  gridImport = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_grid_import_daily_wh[1d]))),
  homeEnergy = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_home_energy_daily_wh[1d]))),
  loadpointEnergy = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_loadpoint_energy_daily_wh[1d])) or vector(0))
)
clamp_max(clamp_min(1 - gridImport / clamp_min(homeEnergy + loadpointEnergy, 0.001), 0), 1)

WITH (
  pvEnergy = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_pv_energy_daily_wh[1d]))),
  gridExport = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_grid_export_daily_wh[1d])))
)
clamp_max(clamp_min((pvEnergy - gridExport) / clamp_min(pvEnergy, 0.001), 0), 1)

WITH (
  monthlyImport = sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_grid_import_cost_daily_eur[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_year, local_month),
  monthlyExport = sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_grid_export_credit_daily_eur[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_year, local_month),
)
label_join(
  label_set(monthlyImport - monthlyExport, "kind", "Costs"),
  "series", " ", "local_year", "kind"
)
